davidoff--winston-churchill.description: Davidoff's tribute to Sir Winston blends tobacco from the Dominican Republic, Nicaragua and Mexico under a glossy, slightly reddish Ecuadorian wrapper. Conceived as a daytime cigar, it is refined and layered: cream and nuts, black coffee and leather, with a dry edge of pepper and cedar.

thirds.notes: A soft, subtly sweet start of almond and cream, with the spice mostly on the nose.
Creamy oak takes the lead, with mocha and a light citrus lift.
Creamy nuts come forward with espresso, leather and hay toward a woody finish.

sources.title: Davidoff – Winston Churchill «The Original Series» Robusto

davidoff--aniversario.description: A cornerstone of Davidoff's white-label range, the Aniversario is handmade in the Dominican Republic with a golden Ecuadorian Connecticut wrapper over aged Dominican binder and filler. Mild and polished, it offers almond, cream and coffee with cedar and a light touch of spice, and finishes mellow.

sources.title: Cigar Inspector – Davidoff Special R review

thirds.notes: In the Special R, honey and vanilla lead with a hint of allspice, and lemon and a meringue-like sweetness appear late in the third.
The smoke thickens and turns creamier, with milk chocolate and a marzipan-like almond note.
Honey and vanilla return strongly before the smoke dries toward a charred, ashy finish.

davidoff--grand-cru.description: Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the Grand Cru wraps well-aged Dominican binder and filler in a glossy Connecticut-seed leaf grown in Ecuador. It is mild and creamy, with cedar, cereal grain, fresh grass and a soft spice over a mellow, slightly butterscotch-sweet base, finishing gently.

sources.title: The Cigar Authority – Davidoff Grand Cru Robusto review

thirds.notes: Earth and hay come first, then a subtle cayenne spice, with licorice and cedar in the aroma and a faint barnyard note.
Light spice continues beside butter and cream, and wood begins to build past the halfway point in a smooth, creamy smoke.
Wood moves to the front with earth and hay behind, and cedar stands out on the retrohale and the finish.

davidoff--signature.description: Signature is Davidoff's classic white-label blend: vintage Dominican long filler under a silky Ecuadorian Connecticut wrapper, rolled mostly in slender ring gauges. Mild and smooth, it shows almond and cashew, coffee bean, a hint of fennel and a mossy note, suited to a quiet morning or an after-lunch smoke.

sources.title: The Cigar Authority – Davidoff Signature Toro review

thirds.notes: Honey, earth and cedar open with a licorice note that the retrohale brings forward.
Licorice dominates with touches of molasses, then cedar becomes the core from the midpoint, with some pepper through the nose.
Earth grows heavy with hints of hay and grain, cedar lingers on the finish and the retrohale stays lightly spicy.

davidoff--millennium-blend.description: Millennium Blend wraps aged Dominican long filler in an oily, deep-brown Ecuadorian leaf, and is fuller than the classic Davidoff profile. Medium in strength, it brings leather, earth and oak with nutmeg, set off by hints of moss and black cherry.

sources.title: Casa Sfumando – Davidoff Millennium Blend Tubo Robusto review

thirds.notes: A smooth start of cedar, nuts, light spice and dried fruit, with white pepper and cocoa on the retrohale.
Leather and cocoa step forward as the dried fruit fades, and a red-wine richness and toasted bread appear later.
Spice, nuts and cedar strengthen, licorice and caramel emerge, and the last puffs bring coffee and a herbal note.

davidoff--nicaragua.description: Davidoff's Nicaragua is made entirely from Nicaraguan tobacco: a ten-year-old Cuban-seed rosado wrapper, a binder from Jalapa and filler from Estelí, Condega and the volcanic island of Ometepe. Medium-bodied and refined, it offers walnut, maple-like sweetness, nutmeg, toast and a touch of moss.

sources.title: Holt's Clubhouse – Davidoff Nicaragua Toro review

thirds.notes: A spicy opening gives way to cream, caramel, vanilla and cedar, with cinnamon and a coconut-like sweetness.
Creamy and gentler, with vanilla, nuts and a toffee-like sweetness, and only a touch of spice.
The blend opens up: leather and oak with a peppery kick, coffee, cinnamon, cocoa and earth, and a longer finish.

davidoff--nicaragua-box-pressed.description: The box-pressed, fuller sibling of Davidoff Nicaragua, this blend puts an oily Nicaraguan oscuro wrapper over aged Nicaraguan long filler. Full in strength, it is nutty and intense, with earth, cereal, a hickory-like smokiness and a peaty spice, better kept for the evening.

davidoff--escurio.description: Escurio is Davidoff's nod to Brazil: handmade in the Dominican Republic with an Ecuadorian Habano wrapper, a Brazilian binder and Brazilian and Dominican filler. Medium to full, it balances sweet and spicy, with leather, nuts, cinnamon and licorice, and burns slowly and cool.

sources.title: Blind Man's Puff – Davidoff Escurio Robusto blind review
The Cigar Authority – Davidoff Escurio Robusto review

thirds.notes: Sweet cream and milk chocolate lead, with hay, cedar, damp earth and oily white pepper; licorice and wood show on the finish.
Spice gathers and the creaminess grows, as the Brazilian and San Vicente leaf bring earth, hay, cinnamon and a hint of vanilla.
Milder now, mainly sweet cream and cedar, with grassy hay, wood, a little coffee and vanilla on the retrohale.

davidoff--yamasa.description: Yamasa is named after the Dominican region where Davidoff grows both the wrapper and the binder for this blend. Dominican and Nicaraguan long filler complete it; medium-bodied, it shows coffee, cedar and pepper with a peaty, earthy edge, well suited to an unhurried afternoon.

sources.title: JR Cigars Blending Room – Davidoff Yamasa review
Blind Man's Puff – Davidoff Yamasa Toro blind review

thirds.notes: Black pepper opens, then oak, leather and cocoa arrive with a peaty, earthy edge and a warm, milky retrohale.
Espresso, sweet cream, oak and earth balance one another, with pepper strongest through the nose.
Wood, leather, cocoa and coffee come together, and strength and body build toward a peppery, creamy finish.

davidoff--puro-dominicano.description: Part of Davidoff's stronger Black Band series, this blend is made only from Dominican tobacco, with a wrapper from Yamasá and long filler from several Dominican growing regions, aged for many years. Medium to full, it offers brown sugar, bread, earth and oak with dried fruit, and a creamy finish of leather and spice.

davidoff--winston-churchill-the-late-hou.description: The Late Hour is the evening counterpart to Davidoff's Winston Churchill: Dominican and Nicaraguan long filler, with tobacco rested six months in single malt Scotch casks, under an Ecuadorian Habano wrapper with a San Andrés binder. Medium to full, it carries coffee, pepper and wood with a whisky-like depth.

sources.title: Holt's – Davidoff Winston Churchill The Late Hour
Cigar Inspector – Davidoff Winston Churchill Late Hour Robusto review
Cigora Community – Staff review Davidoff Winston Churchill The Late Hour Robusto

thirds.notes: A caramel-like sweetness with cedar and leather, held together by a mild spice from the wrapper that soon fades.
Sweetness stays to the fore, with cocoa and dark coffee joining leather and cedar as the intensity eases a little.
Sweeter and more layered, with wood, nuts and roasted coffee and a long, lingering finish.

davidoff--cigarillos.description: Davidoff's cigarillos use a cinnamon-coloured Sumatra wrapper over a blend of Brazilian and Indonesian tobaccos, including leaf from Java. Mild and quick, they offer cream, coffee and a little pepper; the Silver Mini is a touch lighter than the Gold Mini.
